# Data flows and workflows

**Owner:** Software Architect

One file per user-visible action, each with an overview diagram (who sends what data to which component and store) and a detailed sequence diagram (every request and every data-store round trip). The LLD is the authority; a flow file draws its contracts and changes in the same edit. File format: the `spec-authoring` skill, Section 3.

## System data flow

_One `flowchart` of the whole system: actors, components, stores and the trust boundary._
